# Turki AlNaif & Partners — تركي النايف وشركاؤه للمحاماة والاستشارات القانونية

> Riyadh-based law firm and legal consultancy (licence no. 4477). Bilingual Arabic/English website. Services: advisory and legal opinions, contracts and transactions, litigation/arbitration/settlement, compliance and governance, digital/data law, enforcement and recovery.
